name: AriaOS Free Antivirus (ClamAV Engine & Quarantine)
description: 100% free, open-source ClamAV antivirus engine integrated with AriaOS: checks signature databases and daemon status, scans files or folders, updates signatures with freshclam, and manages an isolated, reversible quarantine vault.

tools.name: av_status
tools.description: Inspect ClamAV engine binaries, signature database freshness, systemd services, and quarantine count.

tools.name: av_scan_path
tools.description: Scan a file or directory for malware using ClamAV (clamdscan if running, otherwise clamscan).

tools.name: av_update_signatures
tools.description: Update free ClamAV malware signature databases via freshclam.

tools.name: av_quarantine_list
tools.description: List all files currently isolated in the AriaOS antivirus quarantine vault.

tools.name: av_quarantine_file
tools.description: Isolate a suspicious or infected file into the reversible AriaOS quarantine vault without deleting it.

path.description: File path to isolate in quarantine.

reason.description: Detected threat name or reason for isolation.

tools.name: av_restore_file
tools.description: Restore a quarantined file back to its original path (fails safely if a file already exists there).
